name: Glyph Market Notebook
description: Build a small picture-language from a living illustrated market, then validate it on fresh notebook pages.
natural_language: Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Explore the market scenes, inspect every marked context, collect the invented glyphs into the notebook, write a provisional note for each, then match glyphs to the fresh illustration cards on every validation page. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM, page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload, navigation, browser extensions, or external applications. Do not switch to or interact with any unrelated, blank, browser-settings, or non-task tab; tabs opened by a visible task control are allowed only when they are part of this task.

metadata.notes: Distributed visual evidence, provisional annotations, and exact matching to novel illustrated validation cards.
